Name: The English version of the Dottore mod
Author: bubobubocitrus
Description:
"This is the English version of the Dottore mod. Since my native language is Chinese, the new content for this mod was created with the assistance of AI. If anyone would like to make modifications or produce a re-translation, please feel free to do so.

[color=#6d9eeb][size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42516]The main file[/url] now includes the English version, so you don't need to download this patch anymore.[/b][/size][/color]
-------------------------
All the following English translations are AI-generated.

A sleep cycle is required to initialize the character's schedule if you install this mod mid-game.

First and foremost, this is an Unofficial Update!! 
Original Mod Creator: CometBoba (Nexus Mod ID: 18341). The author has not released an update since version 1.5.6. (I tried reaching out via email, but unfortunately, it hasn't been read).
1.6 Version Update By: Bubobubocitrus (Qin)

Requires:
SMAPI - Stardew Modding API — Nexus Mod ID:2400 SMAPI 
Content Patcher — Nexus Mod ID:1915
Custom Fixed Dialogue — Nexus Mod ID:6358
Trinket Tinker — Nexus Mod ID:29073


Changelog / New Features:
-Rearranged Marriage Room Map
-New Additions (Gifted via Mail):
         A summonable Coal Chicken Trinket (Triggers healing on crit).
         Three new Sumeru Cookbooks.
         Two minor new Weapons.
-New Merchant & Crops: Added Ararraycan (Seed Merchant) and various Sumeru-specific crops.
-Schedule Overhaul: Adjusted daily routines and festivals for better SVE (Stardew Valley Expanded) compatibility.
-Doctor-Themed Furniture: Added new decorative items (Looks like Ararraycan is branching into furniture sales!).
-Bug Fix & Trigger Update: Resolved the 12-Heart Event bug and modified its activation requirements.
-Dialogue Expansion: Added and revised various NPC texts (Special thanks to my friends for the RP inspiration!).

Installation 
- Prerequisite: Install the base [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42516]Dottore mod[/url]﻿ first.
- Download this mod package and extract the files.
- Merge the extracted folder with your existing Dottore mod directory, overwriting the original files when prompted.

Following the original approach, you can find details regarding Dottore's preferences, schedule, friendship event triggers, and methods for obtaining new items in the README.txt file (located inside the extracted mod folder).
